name: load-planner-heavy
description: Load scenario planner-heavy (ticket 19.1): two sequential `planner` steps, each injecting 8 `llm` worker steps that fan into a `join`, driving two runtime graph expansions (store.ExpandRun) per run. Each planner is a mock `llm` whose prompt IS a valid PlanOutput returned verbatim by the mock's structured-echo, so the expansion runs fully offline. Stresses the completion-transaction expansion path and graph-mutation write amplification (hypothesis H2) alongside the join-counter contention of the injected fan-in. Model `mock/load-fast`.
